riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who take animals' feelings seriously. Animals cannot speak, but they remember every act of care.
riasec_fit_block.interest: One of the warmest moments in this work is when a fearful cat finally rubs against you. A newly sheltered cat can tremble in a corner, but after you replace its water, bring food, and speak gently every day, it can offer its head to your hand a month later. You have earned an animal's trust.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Social S

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「把动物的感受放在心上」的人——它们不会说话，但你的每一分细心，它们都记得。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最暖的时刻是「一只怕人的猫终于肯蹭你」：刚进收容所的猫缩在角落发抖，你每天换水添粮、轻声跟它说话，一个月后它主动把脑袋往你手上送——你赢得的是一份动物的信任。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 社会型 S

breadcrumb.label: First Line Supervisors Of Firefighting And Prevention Workers

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This role suits people who treat building a capable crew as a mission. Team members trust you with their lives, and you develop them into a disciplined force.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The weight of this role comes from responsibility for crew lives. Before every response, you inspect equipment. On every fireground, you direct entry and withdrawal. You never operate alone because a crew that trusts you stands behind each decision.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising E + Realistic R + Social S

breadcrumb.label: 消防与预防工人一线主管

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「带好一支队伍」当使命的人——队员把命托付给你，你把队伍带成铁军。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最有分量的地方在于「你为队员的生命负责」：每次出警前检查装备、每次火场里指挥进退，你不是一个人在战斗，你身后是一队信任你的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 企业型 E + 实际型 R + 社会型 S

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who follow rules, work steadily with their hands, and are not picky about the environment. Seeing a product you made reach a store shelf and sell is a straightforward source of pride in food production.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The value of this work lies in turning a recipe into a product. Every ingredient you load and every degree of temperature you control becomes food on a store shelf. People who value stability, accept the plant environment, and willingly follow procedures can find a steady rhythm here.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「守规矩、动手稳、不挑环境」的人——看着自己做的产品上货架、被买走，就是食品人最朴素的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在「把配方做成产品」：你投进去的每一种料、控制的每一度温度，最后都变成货架上的食物。喜欢稳定、不怕车间环境、愿意按流程做事的人，会在这里找到踏实的节奏。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 常规型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you remain curious about health informatics and accept judgment under relatively high exposure, this occupation is worth considering.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops the ability to translate between medicine and code. It requires understanding both clinical practice and systems, suiting meticulous, rule-conscious people who enjoy removing barriers.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers research and analysis, structured rules, and practical implementation (Investigative I + Conventional C + Realistic R).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Health Informatics Specialists有持续好奇、又不排斥高风险下的判断，健康专员值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在医疗和代码间翻译」——既要懂临床，也要懂系统。适合细致、守规矩、爱打通壁垒的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好研究分析、重规范、也动手实现（研究 I + 常规 C + 现实 R）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine an outgoing nature, steadiness, and accountability for results. Rooms must fill, teams must perform, and reputation must be protected.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops the ability to protect experience amid crowds. Managers understand operations and revenue while confidently handling full occupancy and complaints. It suits outgoing, steady people willing to accept responsibility for results.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical work, helping others, and creativity (Enterprising E + Conventional C + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「外向 + 稳 + 对结果负责」凑一块的人——房要满、人要带、口碑要护。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在人海里保体验」——既要懂运营与收益，也要有把爆满和投诉都接住的底气。适合外向、稳得住、又愿意对结果负责的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、助人、也创造（企业 E + 常规 C + 社会 S）。

breadcrumb.label: Milling And Planing Machine Setters, Operators, And Tenders, Metal And Plastic

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who enjoy bringing precision back into range with their own hands. Every qualified part confirms their focus and craftsmanship.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The value of this work lies in precision. Parts with tight tolerances can only be produced by skilled milling professionals. People who enjoy machinery, are sensitive to dimensions, and are willing to learn CNC programming can find technical fulfillment here.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Investigative (I)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合享受「精度在手里归位」的人——每一个合格零件，都是对专注与手艺的确认。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在「精度」——公差卡得严的零件，只有铣削师傅做得出来。喜欢机械、对尺寸敏感、愿意学数控编程的人，会在这里找到技术成就感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 研究型 I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine steady hands, tolerance for lengthy training, and patience. Retinal images must be interpreted accurately, surgery must be performed steadily, and vision must be monitored over time.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field demands precision and patience. You must identify tiny retinal lesions accurately and keep your hands steady at a microscopic scale. It suits people with steady hands who can concentrate for long periods and remain committed to patients with chronic eye disease.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers investigation, helping others, and practical work (Investigative I + Social S + Realistic R).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把手稳、耐长学制、有耐心凑一块的人——眼底要读得准，刀要做得稳，视力要盯得久。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练精细加耐心——你既要读得准眼底的微小病变，也要在手米级上把刀做稳。适合手稳、坐得住、又愿意长期跟一个眼病的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好研究、助人、也务实（研究 I + 社会 S + 务实 R）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine attention to detail + empathy + willingness to act. Processes must be understood, families reassured, and resources aligned.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops the ability to find paths for people within institutions. It requires understanding processes and insurance as well as patience to reassure anxious families. It suits attentive, empathetic people willing to navigate systems on others' behalf.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers helping others and practical creation (Social S + Enterprising E + Investigative I).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细心 + 共情 + 愿意奔走」凑一块的人——流程要懂、家属要稳、资源要对。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在制度里替人找路」——既要懂流程与保险，也要有把焦虑家属稳下来的耐心。适合细心、能共情、又愿意在系统里替人奔走的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好助人、也务实创造（社会 S + 企业 E + 研究 I）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people with steady hands, attention to detail, and tolerance for workshop noise. Shaping a pattern and producing a conforming casting from it provides a craftsperson's sense of achievement.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The pleasure of this trade lies in going from wood to metal. Your pattern is not decorative; it must be cast, measured, and revised to exact dimensions. People who enjoy hands-on work, have patience, and can turn drawings into real objects find the grounded satisfaction of craftsmanship here.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Artistic A + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「手稳、心细、耐得住车间噪音」的人——型板从你手里成型、浇出合格的铸件，就是手艺人的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的乐趣在「从木头到金属」：你做的型板不是摆设，是要拿去浇铸、量尺寸、改到分毫不差的。喜欢动手、有耐心、能把图纸读懂做实的人，会在这里找到手艺人的踏实感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 艺术型 A + 常规型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you remain curious about postal service mail carrier work and are comfortable making judgments in a medium-risk environment, this career is worth considering.
riasec_fit_block.interest: What this career develops most is the ability to get each item into the recipient's hands. It requires physical stamina and careful, error-free work. It suits dependable people with a strong sense of direction who do not mind walking the same routes repeatedly.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on work, follows procedures, and coordinates operations (Realistic R + Conventional C + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Postal Service Mail Carriers有持续好奇、又不排斥中风险下的判断，邮政服务邮件投递员值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「把事送到人手里」——既要腿脚好，也要细心不出错。适合踏实、记路强、不怕反复走的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好动手操作、重规程、也讲调度（现实 R + 常规 C + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career combines organization + numbers + persistence. You can follow orders from requisition to warehousing and motivate suppliers to act.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career develops attention to detail + pacing. One order passes through several stages from requisition to warehousing, and missing one can interrupt supply. It suits organized, numerate people who can push progress among multiple parties.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers organized, rule-based work and coordination (Conventional C + Enterprising E + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「条理 + 数字 + 会催」凑一块的人——单子从请购到入库你都能跟住，也催得动供应商。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「细致 + 节奏」——一笔单子从请购到入库要跟好几个环节，漏一个就断供。适合有条理、数字敏感、能在多方之间催进度的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好有条理、重规则、也愿协调（常规 C + 企业 E + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people naturally curious about maps and data. What others see as scenery becomes information awaiting interpretation, creating a distinctive and lasting way of seeing the world.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most interesting part of this work is seeing the world from another perspective. Others see scenery in a satellite image; you identify flooded land, weak crops, and illegal construction. Using data to answer real-world questions is the field's most compelling aspect.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Realistic R + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「对地图和数据有天然好奇」的人——别人眼里的风景，在你眼里是待解译的信息，这种看世界的独特方式，是这行最持久的乐趣。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最有意思的是「换个视角看世界」：别人看一张卫星图是风景，你看得出哪片地淹了、哪块田收成不好、哪里在违规建设。用数据回答现实问题，是这行最上瘾的部分。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 现实型 R + 常规型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine patience + empathy + communication. Residential life must be stable and harmonious, and conflicts must be resolved with warmth.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career develops patience + communication. You handle routine details and conflicts while genuinely caring about residents' conditions. It suits patient, empathetic people willing to remain close and available.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers helping, practical, and leadership-oriented work (Social S + Enterprising E + practical Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「耐心 + 共情 + 会沟通」凑一块的人——住要安稳也要顺，矛盾要解也要暖。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「耐心 + 会沟通」——既要处理琐事和冲突，也要真心关心住宿者的状态。适合有耐心、会共情、也愿意守在身边的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好助人、务实、也带队（社会 S + 企业 E + 现实 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you remain curious about supply chain management and do not avoid high-stakes judgment, this career is worth considering.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field most strongly develops the ability to find balance amid uncertainty. Managers must understand data and contracts, contain multiple concurrent crises, and keep cost, lead time, and service from failing. It suits calm coordinators who accept responsibility.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: They prefer leadership, order, and investigation (Enterprising E + Conventional C + Investigative I).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Supply Chain Managers有持续好奇、又不排斥高风险下的判断，供应链经理值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在不确定里找平衡」——既要读得懂数据与合同，也要压得住多线并发的火，还得让成本、交期、服务三方都不塌。适合冷静、爱统筹、能扛事的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好主导、秩序、也探究（企业 E + 常规 C + 研究 I）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who can develop an attachment even while wrestling with steel. Watching a die you made produce its first qualified parts provides an addictive sense of accomplishment.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The satisfaction comes from making something with exact precision. A well-made die can produce one hundred thousand parts without problems, creating a tangible sense of trust. This work suits people who can concentrate, have steady hands, and insist on precision.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「跟钢铁较劲也能较出感情」的人——看着自己做的模具打出第一批合格零件，那种踏实感很上瘾。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的成就感在于「做一个东西做到分毫不差」——一个模具做出来，能打十万件产品不出问题，那种被信任的感觉很实在。适合坐得住、手稳、对精度有执念的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 研究型 I + 事务型 C
